description: This file declares classes related to media pipeline capabilities, including a factory class for creating media pipeline capabilities and the main class 'MediaPipelineCapabilities' which provides methods to query supported MIME types and check MIME type support. It also includes necessary headers and namespace declarations.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements IMediaPipelineCapabilities, providing media pipeline capabilities such as supported MIME types.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the capabilities with a given IGstCapabilitiesFactory.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
